# Tamper Signal

> Signed receipts for vibe-coded data pipelines. Every pipeline stage signs a receipt; verification reports a traffic light: green (chain intact), yellow (verifies, with caveats), red (broken at an exact link, with the totals delta). This proves continuity, not correctness: it can't tell you the data is right, but it can prove nobody changed it.

Install: `pip install tamper-signal` (Python 3.11+, CLI `receipts`) or `npm install tamper-signal` (Node 18.17+, CLI `tamper-signal`). Chains are interchangeable across the two stacks.

Period-over-period continuity: declare a signed tolerance at ingest (`--band`, `--settle`, `--bucket-column`) and recurring refreshes earn yellow caveats when recent data drifts past the band or settled data moves; `receipts diff` and `receipts log` read the auto-archived run history (weaker evidence than the chain).

Data portability: `receipts export --bundle` writes a verified zip (the data file plus `chain.json` and receipts) a recipient re-verifies offline, and the browser Data tab's "Take your data" exports the attested data client-side (csv/tsv/json/ndjson; xlsx via the CLI). `receipts ingest --as period` continues an existing chain's history under a trusted signer (refusing an untrusted one); `--as replace` (default) re-signs a fresh chain and archives the prior one. The Semantic hash is format-agnostic, so a CSV exported here re-verifies as JSON and the light stays green.

## Docs

- [Integration runbook for coding agents](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/welovejeff/tamper-evident-verification/main/AGENTS.md): the complete install-to-verified path; follow it in order
- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/welovejeff/tamper-evident-verification/main/README.md): overview, CLI, how the chain works, honest limits
- [Domain vocabulary](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/welovejeff/tamper-evident-verification/main/CONCEPTS.md): receipt, chain, semantic hash, the light, spec version
- [Copy rules](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/welovejeff/tamper-evident-verification/main/docs/MESSAGING.md): the verdict lines and banned claims, binding for any UI text you write
- [FAQ](https://tampersignal.com/docs/faq.html): what it proves and what it does not, the traffic light, blockchain, and how it differs from dbt and friends

## Writing

- [Blog](https://tampersignal.com/blog/): notes on keeping AI-built data pipelines honest
- [Data that watches itself](https://tampersignal.com/blog/data-that-watches-itself.html): Tamper Signal 2.0 — the live-source watcher (`tamper-signal watch`) keeps a live API/RSS feed on the same signed chain; new data auto-appends, a change to an already-settled value is withheld for human review (`tamper-signal review`)
- [Your vibe-coded dashboard needs receipts](https://tampersignal.com/blog/your-vibe-coded-dashboard-needs-receipts.html): the pitch, longer; why AI-written data code fails silently and how a signed receipt at every step catches it
- [Your data is supposed to move](https://tampersignal.com/blog/your-data-is-supposed-to-move.html): tolerance bands and run history, so the light stays believable on a pipeline that refreshes every morning
- [Show your work](https://tampersignal.com/blog/show-your-work.html): why every dashboard built on verified data should ship a Data tab, the raw verified rows next to the charts
